name: Griha pravesh pooja
description: The housewarming pooja when you enter a new home. A pandit ji comes to your home, and the samagri is included. You choose the day and time.

name: Vastu shanti pooja
description: A pooja to settle the vastu of a home or a new space. A pandit ji comes to your home, and the samagri is included. You choose the day and time.

name: Satyanarayan katha
description: The katha of Lord Satyanarayan, read at home on an auspicious day. A pandit ji comes to your home, and the samagri is included. You choose the day and time.

name: Naamkaran sanskar
description: The naming ceremony of a newborn. A pandit ji comes to your home, and the samagri is included. You choose the day and time.

name: Mundan sanskar
description: The first hair-cutting ceremony of a child. A pandit ji comes to your home, and the samagri is included. You choose the day and time.

name: Annaprashan sanskar
description: The ceremony of a baby's first solid food. A pandit ji comes to your home, and the samagri is included. You choose the day and time.

name: Vivah sanskar (wedding rites)
description: The wedding rites, performed by a pandit ji. A pandit ji comes to your home, and the samagri is included. You choose the day and time.

name: Birthday ayushya havan
description: A havan on your birthday, with prayers for a long and healthy life. A pandit ji comes to your home, and the samagri is included. You choose the day and time.

name: Vahan pooja
description: A pooja for a new vehicle before its first drive. A pandit ji comes to your home, and the samagri is included. You choose the day and time.

name: Dukan / office opening pooja
description: A pooja to open a new shop or office. A pandit ji comes to your home, and the samagri is included. You choose the day and time.

name: Radha-Krishna prem pooja
description: A pooja to Radha and Krishna, offered for love and a happy relationship. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Gauri-Shankar vivah kamna pooja
description: A pooja to Gauri and Shankar, offered for a wished-for marriage. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Santan Gopal pooja
description: A pooja to Bal Gopal, offered by those wishing for a child. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Kuber-Lakshmi pooja
description: A pooja to Lakshmi and Kuber, offered for prosperity. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Mahamrityunjaya jaap
description: The Mahamrityunjaya mantra chanted for good health and recovery. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Saraswati vidya pooja
description: A pooja to Saraswati, offered for learning and studies. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Ganesh karya-siddhi pooja
description: A pooja to Ganesh, offered for success in work and new beginnings. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Rudrabhishek

name: Hanuman Chalisa path
description: The Hanuman Chalisa recited, offered for strength and protection. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Baglamukhi shatru-vijay pooja
description: A pooja to Maa Baglamukhi, offered by those facing a court case. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Vyapar vriddhi havan
description: A havan offered by those whose business has suffered a loss. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Rin-harta Ganesh pooja
description: A pooja to Ganesh as the remover of debt, offered by those in debt. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Hanuman nazar-dosh path
description: The Hanuman path recited for those who feel troubled by the evil eye. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Karya-badha nivaran pooja
description: A pooja offered by those whose job or promotion keeps getting blocked. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Kalah nivaran pooja
description: A pooja offered for peace in a family after a dispute. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Bhumi vivad nivaran pooja
description: A pooja offered by those in a dispute over land or property. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Shatru shanti pooja
description: A pooja offered by those troubled by enemies or opponents. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Dhan-vapasi Ganesh pooja
description: A pooja to Ganesh, offered by those whose money is stuck or not returned. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Navagraha shanti pooja
description: A pooja to all nine planets together. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Surya graha shanti pooja

name: Chandra graha shanti pooja
description: A pooja to the Moon (Chandra), offered when the Moon is weak or troubled in the chart. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Mangal graha shanti pooja

name: Budh graha shanti pooja

name: Guru graha shanti pooja

name: Shukra graha shanti pooja

name: Shani graha shanti havan

name: Rahu graha shanti pooja
description: A pooja to Rahu, offered when Rahu is troubling the chart. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Ketu graha shanti pooja
description: A pooja to Ketu, offered when Ketu is troubling the chart. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Mangal dosh nivaran
description: A pooja for Mangal dosh (Manglik) in the birth chart, usually done before marriage. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Kaal Sarp dosh nivaran
description: A pooja for Kaal Sarp dosh, when all the planets lie between Rahu and Ketu in the chart. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Pitra dosh nivaran

name: Narayan nagbali pooja
description: A detailed rite for the ancestors, performed by a pandit ji. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Sade sati shanti pooja
description: A pooja to Shani, offered during Sade sati, the seven-and-a-half year period of Saturn. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Guru chandal dosh nivaran
description: A pooja for Guru chandal dosh, when Jupiter is joined with Rahu in the chart. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Grahan dosh shanti
description: A pooja for Grahan dosh, when the Sun or the Moon is joined with Rahu or Ketu in the chart. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Angarak dosh nivaran

name: Shrapit dosh nivaran
description: A pooja for Shrapit dosh, when Saturn is joined with Rahu in the chart. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Gand mool shanti
description: A pooja for a child born in a Gand mool nakshatra. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Nadi dosh nivaran
description: A pooja for Nadi dosh, found when two charts are matched for marriage. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Vish yoga shanti
description: A pooja for Vish yoga, when Saturn and the Moon are joined in the chart. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Kemadruma yoga shanti
description: A pooja for Kemadruma yoga, when the Moon has no planet with it or beside it in the chart. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.

name: Kumbh vivah
description: The symbolic marriage to a pot (Kumbh), done before marriage for Mangal dosh. Done for you by a pandit ji on the date shown.
